investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell script was observed on host SRV-FILE-02 that constructs the LSASS process ID and uses rundll32.exe to invoke comsvcs.dll for a LSASS memory dump to C:\Windows\Temp\debug_report.log. This pattern is commonly used for credential dumping and is highly suspicious on Windows Server 2019 Standard. The activity involves a user session from 10.2.40.15 and is indicative of potentially malicious activity requiring escalation.
